name: P. S. Carli, Eagle Tavern
trade: tavern keeper, and dealer in chairs, harnesses and saddles

proprietors.name: P. S. Carli
proprietors.basis: The register matches the printed name to the town card carli_p_s (action: enrich), so this is the same person the resident layer already holds. Dated by the printing window, which bounds the reading and does not date the partnership.

locations.basis: Placeable against the committed town. The landmark is another documented business (business_eagle_tavern), which places this one exactly as well as that one is placed.
locations.limit_reason: The register places this house against business_eagle_tavern and the town holds no roof of its own for it (action: new_building), so the anchor is as far as the reading goes.

dates.basis: No opening is announced. The first printing, 1834-07-09, is the bound: the house was trading by then and the record does not say when it began.

replaceable_by: A directory, a deed or a later reading that names this house's premises, its staff or its dates more exactly than the newspapers do.
